name: speech-kerry
about: Spoken dialogue fitted to ONE Cyberpunk 2077 character (26 lines; the game's JALI lipsync layer vs their voice). Jaw correlation with that character: 0.79. Use speech-cyberpunk unless you want this one voice.
source: Cyberpunk 2077 (measured numbers only; no game data is included)

notes.jaw_mean: loudness (dB after normalising) -> average jaw opening (0..1) at that loudness
notes.peakiness: 0 = follow the average, 1 = follow the peaks
notes.contrast: >1 snaps shut between syllables and opens wider on them
notes.normalize_to_db: the loud end (95th percentile of voiced frames) is shifted to this level
notes.open_lead_ms: jaw starts opening this long before the sound
notes.close_lead_ms: jaw starts closing this long before the sound stops
notes.follow_jaw: tracks that ride along with the jaw: value = gain x jaw
notes.shape_lead_ms: diction shapes run this far ahead of the sound
notes.symmetric: true = left and right always match (game dialogue does)
notes.upper_face: voice-driven blinks, brows, squints, gaze and head (see docs/PROFILES.md)
notes.closure_peak: the strongest a p/b/m press gets (other lip shapes give way under it)
notes.mood_auto: --mood auto: a guess from the voice. score = (pitch - pitch_ref)/pitch_scale + (loudness - loud_ref)/loud_scale - (pitch range - range_ref)/range_scale; above threshold -> intense, else calm
notes.neck_during_speech: neck/throat tracks held at the game's average level while talking (they don't follow jaw, loudness or pitch in the game data)
notes.soft_attack_ms: lip and tongue shapes other than p/b/m presses ease in (ms); the game's change no faster than this
notes.tongue_contrast: how much the tongue's per-sound shapes are exaggerated over the game's averages (which timing blurs)
notes.lip_mode: learned: soft lip shapes learned from the game that blend from sound to sound (p/b/m and f/v stay crisp); shapes: one fixed shape per sound (0.2.x)
notes.lip_contrast: how much the learned lip shapes are exaggerated over the game's averages
notes.face_smooth_ms: a final, slight zero-phase smoothing over the whole face (blinks and p/b/m presses stay crisp); 0 = off
notes.audio_lips_gain: without words, lips come from the sound (model/audio_lips.json); the regression shrinks peaks to about half the game's, so they're scaled up by this

notes.blink_peak: how far a blink closes the lids (0..1)
notes.blink_in_pause: share of blinks moved into the nearest pause (within 0.7 s)
notes.brow_raises_per_minute: most brow raises per minute, on the strongest syllables
notes.brow_raise_threshold: a syllable needs at least this emphasis (loudness 0..1 + pitch) to raise the brows
notes.brow_lead_ms / brow_attack_ms / brow_hol: brow raise timing around the syllable
notes.pitch_weight: how much pitch (vs loudness) counts as emphasis; 0 skips pitch tracking
notes.frown_level: brows lower and eyes narrow up to this much on loud, low-pitched stretches
notes.loud_squint / loud_cheek: squint and cheek raise on loud passages (effort, singing)
notes.prosody_raise: rising pitch lifts the brows (weight). Against the game's faces: helped singing (frown corr 0.32 -> 0.35), hurt speech (0.232 -> 0.189). Off by default
notes.prosody_tense: loud, fast, high delivery frowns and squints further (weight). No effect on the match to the game's faces (0.230 -> 0.233). Off by default
notes.prosody_calm: calm, low-energy stretches relax the face (weight). No effect on the match to the game's faces in speech. Off by default
notes.prosody_cheek: tense delivery lifts the cheeks (weight); authored, not measured (the game's dialogue never moves the cheek tracks). Off by default
notes.prosody_nose: tense delivery wrinkles the nose (weight); authored, not measured. Off by default
